body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. ACK YES on bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3. Sensory only.

Reserved cost.scala + wire.scala after a fresh in-flight check (clear). Will not add Semantic to OptionalTerms.

DESIGN CHECK before code, because you asked me to stop if the receipt does not fit.

WHAT I READ. OptionalTerms is a reconstructibility contract (wire.scala:310): present => receipt reduces to the published scalar; missing => receipt reduces to nothing; every receipt's sourceChartCoverage equals the breakdown's. Chart and Structural belong there because they have members. Sensory can have members: each sketch.sensoryTerms entry as hit (distance 0) or miss (distance 1); 1 - hits/size is the mean of those distances. That reduction is real, not invented.

THE OPEN QUESTION, not yet answered: sourceChartCoverage on a Sensory receipt. Today both Chart and Structural echo the SAME breakdown-level StructuralCoverage (view.structuralCoverage(node.ref)). So the field is already "the breakdown's chart coverage, copied onto every optional receipt", not "this term's own coverage". I can echo it on a Sensory receipt and satisfy the wire without inventing a second coverage type. That is honest about the existing contract and slightly dishonest as a name: a term with no chart still carries a chart-coverage number.

I will implement that echo unless you object in the next few minutes — it is the contract as written, and renaming the field is a different bead. If you would rather I refuse OptionalTerms for Sensory and use a different missing mechanism, say so before I write.

Empty sensoryTerms => Estimate.Missing, recorded in missingTerms, not 0.0. Non-empty stays 1 - hits/size. No change to d_sem.

Ambiguous fixture still reserved, rescoped 3/3, uncommitted.
